entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Diana, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. I'm looking at my account right now, let's get this done.
Okay, I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
What kind of a question is that? I just don't want it anymore! I've completely changed my mind. It was a total impulse buy and I just don't use it. This shouldn't be a 20-question interrogation.

I understand, and I apologize if it came across that way. I just need to categorize the return in our system. Let me pull up your account... I see you're a VIP member, thank you for your loyalty. Okay, I see the purchase was delivered 32 days ago.

I don't care if it was 32 days or 32 minutes ago. Are you going to take it back or not? Because if you tell me I have to go to some third-party resale site, I'm going to lose my mind. I want my money back from VeloFit, not from some stranger online! Get me your manager!
There's no need for that, sir. I'm sure we can resolve this. Please allow me just one moment to check our official return policy for you. I want to make sure I get you the correct information.
Fine. But you have one minute before I start writing reviews, and trust me, they will not be pretty.

I understand your frustration. Let's see... Okay, I've just consulted our knowledge base. It states that all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it 32 days ago, you are well within that window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund right now.
Oh. It's within 90 days? So you can do it?

Yes, absolutely. As a VIP member, we want to make sure you're satisfied. I have just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just pack the band back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it in the mail.
Huh. Well, okay then. That's what you should have said in the first place. A full refund, you said?
Yes, a full refund to your original payment method once our warehouse receives the item. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
